newsitem.title: FINLAND: EERO SUUTARI SAYS SOLD PONSSE STAKE.
newsitem.headline: EERO SUUTARI SAYS SOLD PONSSE STAKE.

text.p: Eero Suutari, one of the biggest owners in Finnish forestry harvester maker Ponsse Oy, said on Thursday he had sold his 9.3 percent holding in the company.

"I wanted to reduce my risk concentration as I am not anymore involved in the daily operations of the company," Suutari -- the former managing director of a company part of Ponsse -- told Reuters by telephone.

Suutari said he did not know who was the buyer in the transaction of 325,000 Ponsse shares traded in-house by Protos. The price per share was 75.00 markka, up 0.60 on Wednesday's close. Ponsse shares later rose to a year-high 78.00 markka.
